title: Vendor credit lookup offers an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part from [Vendor-1], quantity 4, set inactive in Setup. [Part-B] = one tracked part from [Vendor-1], quantity 4, active. Their numbers share the start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VCR-0.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Vendors, click "New Vendor", type Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL VCR Vendor"), click "Save & Close". [Vendor-1] = that vendor.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL VCR PART A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VCR-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00), Vendor [Vendor-1]; leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  3. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VCR-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL VCR PART A).
  4. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL VCR PART B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VCR-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00), Vendor [Vendor-1]; leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  5. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VCR-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL VCR PART B).
  6. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  7. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab and [Part-B] on the Active tab, both with quantity 4. If no part lookup can be found on a vendor credit, mark the case Blocked with 'vendor credit part lookup not found'.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Vendors and open [Vendor-1].
  2. Start a new vendor credit for [Vendor-1] (the vendor's credit option).
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VCR-0" in the credit's Part Number lookup.
  4. Pick [Part-A].
  5. Set quantity 1 and amount $10.00 and save the credit.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Both [Part-A] and [Part-B] are offered. [Part-A] carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description; [Part-B] has no tag.
  • Step 4: [Part-A] fills the line with [Desc-A] and its stock (4).
  • Step 5: The credit saves with [Part-A] on it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-R11, S9-R12, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none (board 6.6 shows the vendor return lookup, which the vendor credit shares). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
